parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description:
The page number to display from the returned results. Default value: 1.

**NextToken** and **CurrentPage** are conditional parameters for setting the display results. You can specify either one. If both are specified, **NextToken** takes priority.

For more information about how to use the **NextToken** parameter, see the **NextToken** description.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The ID of the device distribution task. This is the globally unique identifier of the task.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next page. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query.

**NextToken** and **CurrentPage** are conditional parameters for setting the display results. You can specify either one. If both are specified, **NextToken** takes priority.

><notice>
The offset of query results is defined as: **PageSize** × (**CurrentPage** - 1).

If the offset is greater than 10,000, you must pass in the **NextToken** value returned by the previous call to this operation to retrieve **Data**. Otherwise, the request is interrupted and **Data** is not returned.

></notice>

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of distribution tasks to display per page. Maximum value: 200.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the device distribution task.

- **0**: The task is being initialized.

- **1**: The task is running.
 
- **2**: The task is completed. This status only indicates that the distribution task has been executed. It does not indicate that all products and devices are distributed. To obtain the distribution result details, call [QueryDeviceDistributeDetail](~~199533~~).

- **3**: The task is abnormally interrupted.

parameters.name: TargetUid
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the destination account for device distribution.
